##: The source of truth for JETCARP's Scoop manifest. The release workflow fills in the version and the checksum (packaging/package.py manifests) and writes the result to the bucket, github.com/jprodgers/scoop-jetcarp, as bucket/jetcarp.json.
description: Cellular automata on almost any tiling of the plane: an app, a command line, scripting and an MCP server.
notes: Start JETCARP from the Start menu, or with `jetcarp` in a terminal.
Before `scoop uninstall jetcarp`, run `jetcarp uninstall` to undo what JETCARP set up outside its folders (the background host, the login entry, the screen saver).
